gate_text: G1: reference build contains >= 12 live-verified characterized cellulases (met: 15)
G2: >= 40 distinct MGnify candidates pass F1, F2, F3, F4 and F6
G3: >= 15 of the G2 candidates have novelty < 30% to every reference
G4: >= 15 of the top-50 candidates examined in F5 have RCSB template E <= 1e-10 with >= 60% coverage
G5: >= 5 G2 candidates have aliphatic index >= the reference-panel median AND >= 2 cysteine residues
G6: decoy pools yield <= 10% as many gate-counted candidates as the reference pool
